title: Kruk2/jasna: local AI restoration for mosaic blocks in video
friendlyTitle: jasna: a local AI tool that restores mosaic blocks in video
summary: On GitHub's daily trending list, Kruk2/jasna was the highest-rising unpublished AI repository, with about 502 new stars and about 2,800 overall. It is a local app that finds mosaic blocks in a video or image and restores those regions, leaving the rest of the frame alone. The free model is BasicVSR++. A slower LTX diffusion model, for more detail, is limited to supporters and NVIDIA GPUs. The public application source is AGPL-3.0.
friendlySummary: On GitHub's daily trending list, jasna was the fastest-rising AI repository that this newsletter has not already covered. It gained about 502 stars and has about 2,800 in total. It is an app that runs on your computer, finds mosaic blocks in a video or image, and restores those spots. The rest of the picture is left alone. The free model is BasicVSR++. A slower, more detailed model called LTX is for supporters and NVIDIA graphics cards only. The public source is AGPL-3.0.
whyItMatters: If a video has mosaic blocks you want filled in on your own machine, Jasna does that without uploading the file. On an RTX 5090, the project reports restoring a 3-minute-22-second 1080p clip in about 34 seconds with BasicVSR++. LTX needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU, at least 8GB of video memory, and 16GB of RAM.
